binary_encoding: dtype-major f64,f32,flex32,f16,bf16; operations tanh,sin,cos; sorted unsigned inputs; five little-endian dtype-width words input,ideal,staged,allowed_low,allowed_high then u32 intermediate_f32; canonical expected NaNs classify only
chain: each primitive materialized; references cover ACTUAL stored bits via offline legal-neighbor closure through depth 3; three seeds 0,1,64 per dtype/op; independent class/sign/codomain gates; no total-chain error budget

classification_qualification_target.classes: require matching zero/nonzero, infinity and NaN classes; normal and subnormal finite values share numerical qualification
classification_qualification_target.consistency_with_exp_log_v2: preserve the accepted classification policy; no stricter automatic normal/subnormal boundary failure
classification_qualification_target.normal_subnormal_boundary: record finite normal/subnormal changes as diagnostics; accept within the finite step or half neighbor envelope
classification_qualification_target.range: finite outputs must lie in [-1,1]; unexpected infinity always fails
classification_qualification_target.sign: matching sign for every finite nonzero and zero output; NaN output sign/payload not specified
classification_qualification_target.status: independent project gates can be stricter than vendor empirical accuracy figures

comparator_order: apply finite step or half destination-image gate
record ideal/staged differences and every boundary transition
policy.expected_summary_rule: expected equality contains immutable corpus/selection/structure facts only; no mutable maxima or run observations

finite_metric.boundary: representable-step metric, explicitly not a real-error/local-spacing ULP definition

half_acceptance_set.baseline_for_class_and_sign: staged destination reference, not ideal direct destination rounding
half_acceptance_set.center: c = interval-certified RN32(f(exact stored half input))
half_acceptance_set.construction: enumerate ranks rank(c)-2 through rank(c)+2, convert each finite F32 value once to destination RNE, deduplicate
half_acceptance_set.ideal_difference: distance from ideal and staged references is diagnostic; neither changes the acceptance set
half_acceptance_set.independent_checks: zero/nonzero, Inf/NaN class, sign, signed zero, no FTZ, and abs(actual)<=1 all apply even when membership succeeds
half_acceptance_set.interpretation: membership is necessary, not proof of the GPU intermediate or its schedule
half_acceptance_set.specials: exact special inputs use singleton bits or NaN class; no neighbor widening

no_ftz_policy.cos_limit: cos(tiny) rounds to one, so those outputs alone cannot detect input FTZ; Sin/Tanh provide sensitivity
no_ftz_policy.evidence: no public FTZ modifier or visible SASS FTZ is not runtime proof
no_ftz_policy.input_checks: all half finite subnormal inputs included; wide signed subnormal and normal boundary neighborhoods included
no_ftz_policy.rule: expected nonzero to zero fails class qualification, including minimum subnormal code 1 to code 0

production_risks.audit_compatibility: prepare-kernels.py lists burn_float_arithmetic in a blanket LDL/STL rejection gate; observed F64 Sin/Cos helper ABI stack can conflict with that assumption; next full-entry qualification must distinguish ABI stack and actual spills
production_risks.f64_sin_cos: two live mathematical CB4 pointers to the 272-byte global table; observed allocated REL numeric type 2
production_risks.f64_tanh: vendor float reduction seed plus retained double residual/polynomial; no frontend narrowing replacement
production_risks.loader_evidence_limit: user-provided status, not independently inspected here; 12 input witnesses only; full typed trig entry and full regression qualification remain pending
production_risks.loader_status: parent reports real-GPU relocation-probe PASS: 48 comparisons, maximum 1 ULP, guards/tails/source/cache and three guest code hashes match; bundle 248 native CB4 data pointers work on this fixture
production_risks.release_gate: reference preparation alone cannot qualify Burn, compiler changes, loader, Linux parity, or GPU arithmetic

provenance.accuracy_figure_status: CUDA tables report observed maxima from nonexhaustive testing, not guarantees.
provenance.half_status: CUDA hsin/hcos/htanh 0-ULP table entries do not qualify this explicit F32 emulation schedule.
provenance.transfer_status: Sin/Cos CUDA Math figures are explicit project targets for TileIR; end-to-end proof remains pending.

references.bf16: primary staged RNB16(RN32(f(exactB16))); retain ideal RNB16(f(exactB16)) separately
references.f16: primary staged RN16(RN32(f(exact16))); retain ideal RN16(f(exact16)) separately
references.f64: RN64(f(exact64)); tanh Full is the vendor F64 function, not RN64(f(RN32(x)))
references.flex32: same values as F32; preserve Flex32 metadata; no TF32 input quantization
references.half_execution_schedule: exact stored half -> explicit RNE F32 promotion -> F32 Sin/Cos or Tanh Full -> exactly one destination RNE
references.half_schedule_evidence: F2FP packing is allowed only when each logical value has one destination rounding.
references.inputs: integer stored bit patterns decoded to exact dyadic rationals; no decimal/host-libm input oracle
references.nan: null ideal bits represent NaN class; output sign/payload/quiet-bit are observations only

scope.autodiff: full autodiff is already authorized; this forward-only slice makes no backward claim; derivatives and reductions need separate reference qualification

selection_options.finite: finite input and finite ideal output, including zero and subnormals
selection_options.skip_rank_zero: omit rank-0 layout only; retain rank-1 [1]

policy.status: cache-only proposed qualification policy; no production arithmetic, compilation, or GPU result
